tooltip.microdrone.traffic_cone_desc: Right-click to place in 5x5 grid (up to 25 items) / Bare-hand right-click to pick up / Sneak right-click to rotate
tooltip.microdrone.racing_curb_desc: Right-click to place / Automatically aligns angle to curves and straights (Suspension responsive)
tooltip.microdrone.battery_desc: Hold and right-click drone to install / Sneak right-click to remove (Rechargeable via station)
tooltip.microdrone.motor_install_hint: Hold and right-click drone to upgrade motor
tooltip.microdrone.drone_frame_desc: Rigid and lightweight carbon-fiber composite skeletal frame.
tooltip.microdrone.esc_board_desc: High-precision board managing electronic speed control for 4 motors.
tooltip.microdrone.drone_screws_desc: Precision stainless screws fastening motors and structural arms.
tooltip.microdrone.connection_cable_desc: High-temp silicone cables connecting battery and ESC to brushless motors.
tooltip.microdrone.radio_antenna_desc: High-gain omnidirectional antenna enabling ultra low-latency link up to 250m.
tooltip.microdrone.controller_case_desc: Ergonomically contoured handheld housing with matte non-slip grip.
tooltip.microdrone.gimbal_stick_desc: Dual-axis potentiometer assembly for precise flight maneuvers.
tooltip.microdrone.controller_board_desc: Microcontroller PCB that encodes stick inputs into encrypted RF signals.
tooltip.microdrone.tiny_spring_desc: Tension spring ensuring instant, accurate return-to-center for joysticks.
tooltip.microdrone.lcd_screen_desc: Backlit graphical screen displaying real-time telemetry and flight metrics.
tooltip.microdrone.motor_can_tier_1_desc: Balanced gunmetal finish rotor bell for standard RPM applications.
tooltip.microdrone.motor_can_tier_2_desc: Anodized blue lightweight aluminum bell tuned for sporty acceleration.
tooltip.microdrone.motor_can_tier_3_desc: Gold-flashed heat-dissipating rotor bell designed for high-RPM operation.
tooltip.microdrone.motor_can_tier_4_desc: Ultra-lightweight crimson CNC bell engineered for competition racing.
tooltip.microdrone.magnet_wire_desc: Oxygen-free enameled copper winding for high-density stator poles.
tooltip.microdrone.motor_shaft_desc: Ground and heat-treated stainless shaft withstanding extreme centrifugal loads.
tooltip.microdrone.neodymium_magnet_desc: Curved high-grade rare-earth magnet generating intense magnetic flux.
tooltip.microdrone.motor_stator_terminal: Conductive terminal board distributing power from ESC to motor windings.
